resources.string: Type a name or a website to find a login.
This entry has nothing to fill here.
On: your logins appear when you tap a login box
Off: tap to turn it on in Android
This phone has no autofill service support.
Android asks you to confirm. The vault stays locked until you unlock it, then a login box offers the entries that belong to that app or website.
Open Android Settings, search for \"Autofill service\" and choose \"Monsoon Script vault\".
Turn on the vault as your autofill service and your logins appear when you tap a login box in an app or a browser. You can change this later in the vault settings.
